name: campus-ai-monorepo
description: CampusAI - Production RAG College Chatbot & Student Advising System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
